notes.title: Minor Update (#0.034), February 2025
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I have made a few small changes in response to feedback.

Update 0.034 Changes

 Additional performance setting: VSync
 Slight gameplay tweaks: dialogue, environment, easter eggs

Thank you everyone for all of the feedback you have provided!
Not only will I use this feedback on updating The New Apartment, but I will consider it for future projects as well.

Sincerely,
Paul Thomas.
